title: Will hsl-surface in helsinki exceed the beta delay threshold during morning_peak on 2026-06-11?
background: Created as a checked prediction campaign fixture from the ready runner decision. It uses the baseline-only campaign method because transit method options still block non-baseline selection below the comparable-outcome threshold.
resolutionCriteria: Resolve Yes if collected GTFS-RT TripUpdates or equivalent transit delay rows for hsl-surface in helsinki during morning_peak on 2026-06-11 include at least 10 eligible trip-stop observations and at least 20% have delay_seconds >= 300. Resolve No if coverage passes and the ratio is below threshold. Resolve Ambiguous if coverage fails.

validOutcomeSpace.description: Binary outcome: Yes if the network late-observation ratio meets the declared threshold; No otherwise.

incentiveRiskReview.notes: Local transit delay campaign fixture; no passenger-level, fare, enforcement, or public-safety use.
